# VFXEmit

`Emit.luau` is Roqer's VFX emit module, vendored unmodified.

- Source: https://github.com/S4US/Roqer, commit `bf7118b`, `apps/desktop/agent/skills/roblox-animation-vfx/templates/vfx/emit.lua` (header `ROQER_VFX_EMIT 2026-10-03`).
- Author: S4US. Roqer is AGPL-3.0-or-later; S4US gave permission to use this module in the game (DM to the project owner, 2026-10-07).
- Mapped by `default.project.json` to `ReplicatedStorage.VFXEmit`. Type checking is off for `vendor/` (`vendor/.luaurc`).

To update, replace `Emit.luau` with a newer upstream copy, update the commit above, and run `./scripts/check.ps1`.
